title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
马寻可以出宫了，他牵着旺财来到了午门门口，远远的就看到了英武不凡的沐英。沐英看到马寻，立刻开心的行礼，“外甥见过舅舅。”马寻欲言又止，因为沐英比他大几岁，“旺财要出去，带着不要紧吧？”沐英笑着说道，“舅舅多虑了，本就是要牵马骑驴，带着旺财自然不要紧。”马寻看了看四周，小声问道，“你带着我出去也就算了，太子跟着一起出去，人是不是少了点？”沐英就赶紧说道，“还有些护卫在宫外，都是仪鸾司的人，全都是些好手。”仪鸾司，也就是锦衣卫的前身了。马寻就放心了，随后问道，“你打过多少仗？”沐英笑着说道，“外甥十二岁就随陛下在外征战，那会儿陛下围攻集庆，我就侍奉跟前。真要说打仗，十八岁的时候才被授予军职。”沐英继续说道，“就是早些年不知道舅舅在福建，那年我攻破了分水关，后又镇守建宁、节制三卫，要不早就去请舅舅了。”马寻也开玩笑说道，“也是我见识短浅，不知道和你有亲。早知道是自家人，我就去投你。说来我能回来，还是你平了福建。”沐英连忙谦虚说道，“舅舅过誉了，外甥就是一小将，平定福建并非外甥之功。”朱元璋和马秀英的义子不少，但是沐英是极其特殊的一个。八岁的时候就被收养，也一直都带在身边，真的是视如己出。马寻笑着问道，“你现在可有子嗣了？”沐英笑着说道，“有一儿子沐春，现年四岁了。此前侧室也有了身孕，今年该再有一子嗣。”马寻立刻抱怨说道，“那你也不把沐春抱来，我这舅爷爷说什么也该看看甥孙。”沐英连忙说道，“舅舅在宫里，我们不好轻易入宫。一会出宫后，外甥定让家里人前去拜见。”马寻一听有些尴尬，“不好不好，哪能让家里人跟着瞎忙。”沐英就严肃说道，“舅舅是长辈，我等小辈自然是要拜见。”在说话间，一身儒生打扮的朱标走了过来，“舅舅，在和三哥说什么呢？”马寻立刻说道，“和他聊着家常。殿下，今天出宫去哪？”朱标笑着问道，“舅舅，你想去哪？”马寻说道，“要不去沐英府上看看？”“三哥那肯定是要去，今天只去自家亲戚家。”朱标就说道，“那就劳烦三哥让人回去说一声，我和舅舅在家里吃了晚饭再回宫。”

沐英开心说道，“我这就让人去准备！本来想着殿下和舅舅今天忙，就打算让妻妾带着沐春去给舅舅磕个头。”朱标立刻装作不高兴的说道，“三哥，爹娘都说舅舅把自己当外人、不亲近，我看你也是。你看着我长大，总是处处见外。”朱标看了看旁边的旺财问道，“舅舅不骑马？”“旺财这些天只能在院里，有些憋坏了。”马寻心疼的说道，“我就牵它出来走走，殿下，要不然让我住外头好不好？”朱标想都不想的说道，“舅舅觉得院子小了？舅舅还是太见外，您要是想去校场还能有人拦着？天天带着旺财去都没事。”马寻还是不甘心的说道，“到底是宫里，有些不自在，也不能没规矩。”朱标就直接踢皮球，“舅舅想要住在外头，得爹娘做主，我是小辈岂能做长辈的主。”不得不说大明的这位储君实在厉害，这才是少年老成。朱标、沐英骑着马，马寻骑着驴，身边有着一些衣甲鲜明的护卫，就这么走在应天府。朱标说道，“我们先去鄂国公府，鄂国公夫人和娘最为亲厚。”或许是担心马寻不理解，沐英解释说道，“鄂国公现在在北伐，为征虏副将军。”马寻一下子明白了，这是要去常遇春的府邸。“我们先去转一圈，再去汤伯家。汤伯虽说现在在太原，只是爹和他关系最好，福建就是汤伯平定的。”朱标继续说道，“再去周叔家，他和汤伯都是爹的发小。”汤和、周德兴，这也都是朱元璋的发小，论起小时候的关系，比起同乡的徐达更为亲近。朱标继续安排说道，“再去徐叔家转一圈，郭叔、邓叔他们家，下午再去。”马寻只是听着，这些事情他做不了主，现在就是客随主便的状态。刚到鄂国公府，一个粗壮的中年女子立刻领着儿女跪下，“臣妾参见太子殿下。”“国公夫人请起。”朱标温润如玉，笑着说道，“今天奉命领国舅走走亲戚人家，第一家便是鄂国公家。”这个中年女子就是常遇春的妻子常蓝氏，可谓是马秀英当年坐镇后方时的左膀右臂。这个彪悍的女子在常遇春还是绿林好汉的时候就跟着他，还带着个拖油瓶的弟弟蓝玉。要是没有一股子彪悍的作风，早就骨头渣子都没了。听到朱标的话，常蓝氏笑的很开心，而她旁边的一个少女脸色通红。这就是常氏了，常遇春和常蓝氏的嫡女，和朱标同龄。不说指腹为婚，也绝对是青梅竹马、两小无猜，就等着正式下聘了。而在常蓝氏身边还有三个少年，常茂、常升、常森，一个个看起来都是熊孩子的样子，七个不服八个不忿。进了府，常蓝氏关心问道，“皇后殿下近来还好吧？”

Ma Xun could leave the palace. He led Wangcai to the Meridian Gate and saw the heroic Mu Ying from a distance.When Mu Ying saw Ma Xun, she immediately saluted happily, "My nephew has met my uncle." Ma Xun hesitated because Mu Ying was a few years older than him. "Wang Cai is going out, so it doesn't matter if he takes him with him, right?" Mu Ying said with a smile, "Uncle is worrying too much. He is just going to lead a horse and ride a donkey, so it doesn't matter if he takes Wang Cai with him."Xun looked around and asked in a low voice, "It's okay if you take me out. The prince will go out with you. Are there too few people?" Mu Ying quickly said, "There are some guards outside the palace. They are all from the Yiluan Division. They are all good hands." The Yiluan Division is the predecessor of the Jin Yiwei.Ma Xun felt relieved and then asked, "How many wars have you fought?" Mu Ying said with a smile, "My nephew went on an expedition with His Majesty when he was twelve years old. At that time, His Majesty besieged Jiqing, and I served him. If I really want to talk about fighting, I was only awarded a military position when I was eighteen years old." Mu Ying continued, "I just didn't know that my uncle was in Fujian in the early years. That year I broke through the Fenshui Pass, and later guarded Jianning and Jiedong Sanwei, or elseI've already gone to invite my uncle." Ma Xun also joked, "It's because I was short-sighted and didn't know that I was related to you.If I had known that I was a member of my family, I would have gone to you.If I could come back, it would be you who defeated Fujian." Mu Ying said humbly, "My uncle is too famous.It is not his nephew who conquered Fujian." Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying have many adopted sons, but Mu Ying is an extremely special one.He was adopted when he was eight years old and has always been with him. He really treats him as his own.Ma Xun asked with a smile, "Do you have an heir now?" Mu Ying said with a smile, "I have a son, Mu Chun, who is four years old now. The side wife was also pregnant before, and there should be another heir this year." Ma Xun immediately complained, "Then you don't bring Mu Chun, my uncle saidYou should see your nephew." Mu Ying said quickly, "My uncle is in the palace, we can't enter the palace easily.After leaving the palace, my nephew will come to visit him." Ma Xun felt a little embarrassed when he heard this, "No, no, how can we let the family go around?" Mu Ying said seriously., "Uncle is an elder, and the juniors like me naturally want to meet him." While talking, Zhu Biao, dressed as a Confucian scholar, came over and said, "Uncle, what are you talking to third brother?" Ma Xun said immediately, "We were chatting with him about home affairs. Your Highness, where are you going out of the palace today?" Zhu Biao asked with a smile., "Uncle, where do you want to go?" Ma Xun said, "Why don't you go to Mu Ying's house?" "Third brother, I'm sure I'm going. Today I'm just going to my relatives' house." Zhu Biao said, "Then I'll trouble Third Brother to ask someone to go back and let me know. Uncle and I will have dinner at home before returning to the palace."

Mu Ying said happily, "I'll let someone prepare it now! I thought that His Highness and uncle were busy today, so I planned to let my wife and concubines take Mu Chun to kowtow to uncle." Zhu Biao immediately pretended to be unhappy and said, "Third brother, my parents said that my uncle treats me as an outsider and doesn't kiss him."I think you are too. You have watched me grow up, and I always look out for others."Zhu Biao looked at Wangcai next to him and asked, "Uncle, you can't ride a horse.""Wangcai can only stay in the yard these days," Ma Xun said distressedly, "I will take him out for a walk.""How about you let me live outside?"Zhu Biao said without thinking, "Uncle, you think the yard is too small. If you want to go to the school, can someone stop you?"Ma Xun said unwillingly.After all, it's a bit uncomfortable in the palace, and there are no rules." Zhu Biao just kicked the ball, "My uncle wants to live outside, but my parents have to make the decision.How can I be the boss of the elders?" I have to say that the prince of the Ming Dynasty is really powerful, this is young and mature.Zhu Biao and Mu Ying were riding horses, and Ma Xun was riding a donkey, accompanied by some guards in bright armor, just walking in Yingtian Mansion.Zhu Biao said, "Let's go to the Duke of E's Mansion first. His wife and mother are the closest to each other." Perhaps because he was worried that Ma Xun would not understand, Mu Ying explained, "The Duke of E is currently on the Northern Expedition and is the deputy general in the conquest of captives." Ma Xun suddenly understood that he was going to Chang Yuchun's residence."Let's go for a walk first, and then go to Uncle Tang's house. Although Uncle Tang is in Taiyuan now, my father has the best relationship with him. It was Uncle Tang who settled Fujian." Zhu Biao continued, "Let's go to Uncle Zhou's house. He and Uncle Tang were both my father's childhood children."Zhu Biao continued to make arrangements and said, "Let's go to Uncle Xu's house, Uncle Guo and Uncle Deng's house, and then go there in the afternoon." Ma Xun just listened, he couldn't make the final decision on these things, and now he was just following the host's will.As soon as they arrived at the Duke of E's residence, a stout middle-aged woman immediately led her children to kneel down and said, "Concubine, please see His Royal Highness the Crown Prince." "Madam, please rise." Zhu Biao was as gentle as jade and said with a smile, "Today I was ordered to take my uncle to visit relatives' houses. The first one is the Duke of E's house." This middle-aged woman is Chang Yuchun's wife Chang Lan, who can be said to be Ma Xiuying's right-hand man when she was in charge of the rear.This tough woman followed Chang Yuchun when he was still a hero in the forest, and she also brought along her arrogant younger brother Lan Yu.If he didn't have a tough style, his bones would have been gone long ago.Hearing Zhu Biao's words, Chang Lanshi smiled happily, while the girl next to her turned red.This is the Chang family, the direct daughter of Chang Yuchun and Chang Lan family, the same age as Zhu Biao.Not to mention getting married on the fingertips, they are definitely childhood sweethearts and childhood sweethearts, waiting to be formally engaged.There were three teenagers beside Chang Lan, Chang Mao, Chang Sheng, and Chang Sen. They all looked like naughty children, seven of them were dissatisfied and eight were dissatisfied.After entering the mansion, Chang Lan asked with concern, "How are you doing, Her Majesty the Queen?"
